walkthroughs.body_html:
A change in magnetic flux through a coil induces an emf.

Faster change or more turns -> larger emf.

Current in coil in field -> turning force.

Split-ring reverses current each half-turn so motor keeps spinning.

Spinning a coil in a field induces an emf.

Generators in power stations make AC at 50 Hz.
